```{python}
data=data.dropna(subset=["Sales"])
```


```{python}
numerical_features=data.select_dtypes(include=["float64"]).columns
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

for i, column in enumerate(data.columns):
    plt.subplot(2,2,i+1)
    sns.histplot(data[column], color="blue", kde=True)
    plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sns.histplot(data["Sales"], bins=30, kde=True)
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sns.boxplot(data=data, x="Sales", color="darkorange")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sns.pairplot(data)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sns.regplot(data=data, x="TV", y="Sales")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols
model=ols("Sales ~ TV", data=data)
model=model.fit()
print(model.summary())
```

```{python}
sns.histplot(data=model.resid, kde=True)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
import statsmodels.api as sm
sm.qqplot(data=model.resid, line="s")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x=model.fittedvalues, y=model.resid)
plt.axhline()
plt.show()
```
